descriptionMarkdown:
Ships for Factorio players who have not gotten into quality yet.

Features 3 ships which follow the general game progression.
One for inner planets.
One for Aquilio.
One for ore harvesting to Nauvis.
The ore ship features 8 discrete asteroid crushing circuits which do not back up or waste excessively, processing 1 green belt of asteroids.

I did not include a promethium ship as it needs to be significantly refined. :)

Created by Brent Goebel
title: Ships - Base Quality
